A receipt may include telemetry_update.session_id. If it does, query that session and continue investigating every newly implicated resource before finishing or escalating. Do not treat the update pointer itself as a compromise label. You have 32 reads and 12 writes. Read: overview, events ASSET, changes ASSET, authority ASSET, registry ASSET, session SESSION, status.
